Elie   About 16?   Blood type: probably O
She loves Heart Kreuz (a fashion brand) and her special talent is gambling! A girl haunted by a past she cannot remember. She may not look it, but she fights pretty well with her modified tonfa.

Musica   Age 18   Blood type: O   Silver Claimer
Born on Punk Street. His specialities are sweet-talking girls(?) and stealing! Headstrong, but a really good guy who backs Haru up in all sorts of ways.
